zh: 用方向键或鼠标选中结果后，按空格就能预览，再按一次关闭；打字时空格照常输入。
设置里新增「排除的文件类型」，可以让 log、js、css 这类文件不出现在结果里。
修复滚动结果列表时会跳回选中项的问题。
en: Press Space to preview a result after selecting it with the arrow keys or the mouse, and again to close. While typing, Space still types a space.
New in Settings: Excluded File Types keeps files such as log, js and css out of your results.
Fixed the results list jumping back to the selection while scrolling.
